privileged_info_for_vlm: The database is located at /home/ga/chinook.odb. The target table is 'Customer' which contains 13 fields. The final form must be named 'Customer_ReadOnly'. Crucially, in the Form Properties > Data tab, 'Allow additions', 'Allow modifications', and 'Allow deletions' must all be set to 'No' (which corresponds to the internal XML attributes allow-inserts, allow-updates, and allow-deletes being 'false').
